yt.title: Your computer hits 2,000,000,000 on {c_date} #Shorts
yt.description:
Unix time reaches 2,000,000,000 seconds on May 18, 2033 03:33:20 UTC. Computed.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.text: Your computer is counting to 2 billion
scenes.narration: Your computer is quietly counting toward two billion.
Many computers store time as the seconds since January first, nineteen seventy.

scenes.label: at {c_time}
scenes.narration: That count hits two billion on {c_date_say}.
Two billion fits fine. The real trouble is twenty thirty-eight, when old thirty-two bit clocks overflow.
Where will you be when it hits two billion?
